# git

Git log formatting, commit counting across projects, and a couple of everyday branch helpers.

---

## `git_count_commits`

Count non-merge commits by one author in the current repository for a single calendar year. The author string is matched as a substring of the author name and email, so "milan" or an email both work.

**Usage**

```sh
git_count_commits [author] [year]
```

**Examples**

```sh
git_count_commits
git_count_commits milan 2024
```

**Requires** `git`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/git.sh:28`](../../modules/common/git.sh#L28)

---

## `git_count_commits_by_project`

Count an author's commits for every git repository one level below the current directory. Prints "<count> <project>" per line.

**Usage**

```sh
git_count_commits_by_project [author] [year]
```

**Examples**

```sh
git_count_commits_by_project
git_count_commits_by_project milan 2024 | sort -rn
```

**Requires** `git`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/git.sh:53`](../../modules/common/git.sh#L53)

**See also** `git_count_commits`, `git_count_commits_total`

---

## `git_count_commits_total`

Sum an author's commits across every git repository one level below the current directory.

**Usage**

```sh
git_count_commits_total [author] [year]
```

**Examples**

```sh
git_count_commits_total milan 2024
```

**Requires** `git`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/git.sh:74`](../../modules/common/git.sh#L74)

**See also** `git_count_commits_by_project`

## `git_get_default_branch`

Print the repository's default branch, as advertised by the remote. Falls back to main, then master, when the remote HEAD is not set.

**Usage**

```sh
git_get_default_branch [remote]
```

**Examples**

```sh
git rebase "origin/$(git_get_default_branch)"
```

**Requires** `git`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/git.sh:101`](../../modules/common/git.sh#L101)

---

## `git_log_graph`

Print the commit graph in the compact one-line-per-commit format: abbreviated hash, refs, subject, relative date, author.

**Usage**

```sh
git_log_graph [git-log-argument]...
```

**Examples**

```sh
git_log_graph
git_log_graph -20 --author=milan
```

**Requires** `git`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/git.sh:14`](../../modules/common/git.sh#L14)

---

## `git_show_recent_branches`

List local branches most-recently-committed first, with relative date and last author. Useful for finding what you were working on.

**Usage**

```sh
git_show_recent_branches [count]
```

**Examples**

```sh
git_show_recent_branches
git_show_recent_branches 5
```

**Requires** `git`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/git.sh:86`](../../modules/common/git.sh#L86)
